support_claim: Rebranding evidence links Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH via unchanged HRB 88421, but unresolved preservation of multiple live naming variants blocks closing whether billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH and contract:MSA-OAK-2018 denote the same counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Establishes legal-entity continuity between the pre-rebrand name Oakfield Logistics GmbH and the post-rebrand name Oakfield Logistik GmbH via unchanged registry number.

propositions.proposition: CRM still shows the old English-facing name for Oakfield.
propositions.relevance: Preserves multiple live naming variants (English-facing old name vs current Logistik name) without resolving which name a given referent denotes.

propositions.proposition: Handelsregister HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH as active in Germany.
propositions.relevance: Corroborates the current registered legal name Oakfield Logistik GmbH for the entity identified by HRB 88421 referenced in the rebranding note.
Grounds the left referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH to the billed entity name appearing in billing records.

propositions.proposition: MSA-OAK-2018 names its counterparty as Oakfield Logistics GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the counterparty associated with the right referent contract:MSA-OAK-2018 as Oakfield Logistics GmbH; no registry identifier or explicit link to HRB 88421 appears in this observation.
